name: RTU Fallout Remover

features.text: Safely removes calcium, magnesium and iron (from hard water).

description: A ready-to-use, water-thin, crystal-clear solution designed to remove surface fallout, rust, water-spots and other debris. This product is highly concentrated and offers true economy, power and effectiveness.
application: Caution: Avoid contact with plastic, rubber, or chrome trim. If contact occurs, simply rinse area with soapy water. Using rubber gloves, apply solution liberally, and cover surface of vehicle. Let dry 5-10 minutes and vehicle will take on a frosted appearance. Using a wash mitt soaked in solution, scrub vehicle to remove fallout. Wash vehicle with soap and rinse well. Chamois dry if desired.
